headline: United Nations declares epidemic alarm in Gaza as meningitis cases surge rapidly
label: NEWS
caption:
Health authorities have raised grave concerns over the worsening situation in Gaza 🚨

According to Anadolu and Al Jazeera, an epidemic alarm has been declared due to a sharp increase in meningitis cases across the territory.

Vatican News reports that the rise in infections is being driven by a severe water crisis and collapsing infrastructure that has left health systems struggling.

International organizations warn that the deteriorating conditions are fueling widespread health fears for civilians trapped in the area.

What measures can be taken to prevent a wider health catastrophe in Gaza?
